headline: 盧安達傷痕新小說登場
context: 法國-盧安達裔作家 Gaël Faye 推出第二本小說《Jacaranda》，從1994年盧安達種族滅絕寫起，探問創傷過後能不能真正被原諒。另外，亞莉安娜發行新專輯《Petal》，她說這是一張「不加掩飾的怒氣」之作。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This bold family saga explores a search for healing and truth in the aftermath of the Rwanda genocide How to forgive the unforgivable? How to live in the aftermath of atrocity? Following 2016’s Small Country , French-Rwandan rapper and writer Gaël Faye takes on huge questions in his second novel, Jacaranda, which explores the seismic events of the Rwanda genocide and the aftershocks that continue to ripple through the generations. Structurally bold, the story opens in summer 1994 with Milan, Faye’s then 12-year-old protagonist, enjoying an extended break from school. Milan’s father is white French and the family’s life in Versailles is the embodiment of first world ease – their holiday that year, as usual, spent sailing at the Île de Ré. Milan’s mother, though, is Rwandan. Venancia arrived in the 1970s, establishing a life for herself, a successful clothing boutique, a family. However, she cannot share the French ease, much less her thoughts on the disturbing reports from Rwanda now making the evening news. Continue reading...
sources.title: Jacaranda by Gaël Faye review – the limits of forgiveness after Rwanda

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: (Republic) Casting herself as a flower trampled underfoot, the superstar’s eighth album swaps the ​glitz of her Wicked years ​f​or dark blooms of haunted electronics ‘Tell me who’s to blame?” Ariana Grande asks, exasperated, on the title track of her eighth album, Petal. “Is it the people or myself?” As bleary, fuzzed-up drums threaten to drown her out, this shadowy carousel-ride of a song cycles through more questions than answers. Does her success only make her need more of it? Can her new record of No 1 singles stave off heartbreak? Does Grande’s life shape her music, or does her music shape her life? Moody and muted, Petal is a riposte to the glitz and sparkle of the pop star’s Oscar-nominated turn in Wicked and the theatre kid energy of her last album, 2024’s Eternal Sunshine . She describes this record as one of “unfiltered rage”, and there’s plenty Grande could be angry about: just this week she filed a lawsuit against hackers who allegedly stole and sold numerous unreleased songs. Continue reading...

threads_text:
盧安達傷痕新小說登場

法國-盧安達裔作家 Gaël Faye 推出他的第二本小說《Jacaranda》，接續2016年的《Small Country》，故事從1994年盧安達種族滅絕寫起，透過一個家庭三代人，探問創傷過後能不能真正被原諒。

另一則音樂消息：亞莉安娜（Ariana Grande）發行第八張專輯《Petal》，她形容這是一張「不加掩飾的怒氣」之作，風格比前作《Eternal Sunshine》陰鬱許多。她本週也對外宣布，已對竊取並外流她未發行歌曲的駭客提告。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 31 日發佈。
voice_text: 有一本新小說，把盧安達1994年的種族滅絕重新攤開來寫。作者是法國-盧安達裔作家蓋爾・法耶，這是他的第二本小說，故事透過一個家庭三代人，問的是——傷痛過後，原諒到底可能不可能。換個輕鬆一點的。亞莉安娜發了第八張專輯，她說這次是一張不加掩飾的怒氣之作，比上一張陰鬱不少。她本週也對外宣布，已經對外流她未發行歌曲的駭客提告。
